deadEnd.details: The booking engine (aswbe.ana.co.jp) answers every search from an automated proxy session with 'The document registration process could not be completed properly. Please try again later.' (R01P030-message.error.fatalError for international, R01P031 for Japan domestic). No flight list is shown, so the fare, passenger and payment steps cannot be reached.

gotchas: English site: https://www.ana.co.jp/en/us/. A 'Cookie Settings' modal (dialog#ensModalWrapper) intercepts all clicks until 'Apply selection and agree' is pressed; it does not appear in the accessibility snapshot.

Booking widget (Reservations > Tickets): 'One Way' is an li[role=button]. From/To are buttons that open a popover with input[placeholder="Enter the city or airport"]; type the IATA code and click the suggestion row (e.g. 'Tokyo (Haneda), Japan / Tokyo (Haneda), Japan'). The popover is not in the snapshot; use visible CSS/text selectors.
Date: click the date button (e.g. '2026/10/2'), click the day number in the first month, then 'Confirm Selection'; then the Search button.

Both an international route (HND-GMP) and a Japan domestic one (HND-ITM) entered from the US widget fail on the results page with the R01P03x fatalError, twice in a row; the five-step header (Flights, Details, Seats, Payment, Complete) shows that a guest path exists past it.
